case_title: Defective Air Conditioner and Contradictory Statements

additional_evidence_concerns.reason: The complete technical inspection report has not been provided.
A visit record exists, but it does not establish the complete inspection findings.

expected_defects.description: The claimant says the technician did not properly inspect the product, while the respondent says the inspection was completed.
The claimant alleges an original manufacturing defect, but this has not been independently established.
The respondent claims that the product was functioning normally, but conclusive supporting evidence is not available.
The complete technical inspection report is missing.

expected_review.reason: The four standard complaint documents are present, but the missing technical report and conflicting statements require further examination.

expected_outcome.recommended_action: Obtain the complete technical inspection report and examine both parties' statements before reaching a conclusion.

testing_notes: All four standard checklist documents should be marked Present.
The missing technical report must be identified as additional evidence.
The system must identify contradictions between claimant and respondent.
The system must not automatically accept either party's version.
